summary: Iter54 — kasir can change ecommerce sale status and finalize ongkir. 9/9 backend pytest tests passed and full UI flow passed as kasir on /penjualan-online: status dropdown works, estimasi -> isi final input saves ongkir and recalculates total_fee & laba_bersih, final -> ubah edit with cancel preserves value, kasir does NOT see edit/delete Aksi column, admin still sees Aksi. Admin-only guards (delete, full edit, cair put/delete, bulk) remain 403 for kasir.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_ecom_status: uses get_current_user without role check — correctly permits kasir. OK.
finalize_ecom_ongkir: no role check, allows kasir — OK. Logic uses doc.get('laba_kotor',0) directly which is correct.
server.py is 2444 lines — monolithic; recommend splitting into routers per domain (ecommerce, hr, inventory, etc.) for maintainability.

Dikembalikan + restore_stock is idempotent via stock_restored flag — good. However delete_ecom_sale always calls _restore_sale_items regardless of stock_restored flag, which could double-restore stock after a Dikembalikan+delete. Potential bug (pre-existing).
seed_data_creation: Seeded ecommerce sales created and cleaned up via DELETE as admin inside each test; one Dikembalikan test leaves a small stock drift (+1) due to double restore interaction with delete_ecom_sale — noted as pre-existing issue, non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All kasir ecommerce status+ongkir flows pass. If next iteration touches delete_ecom_sale, consider guarding against double restore when stock_restored=true.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found for this iteration's scope.
